name: join-nullable-string-keys
description: Measure nullable String equality and NULL exclusion from JOIN keys

queries.name: nullable-both-keys
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.event_id FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.coupon = f.coupon AND e.event_id = f.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: nullable-left-filter
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.amount FROM events e LEFT JOIN events f ON e.coupon = f.coupon AND e.event_id = f.event_id WHERE f.event_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: nullable-reverse
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.event_id FROM events e JOIN events f ON f.coupon = e.coupon AND f.event_id = e.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 20
